main: run the SNN evaluation pipeline on ImageNet or CIFAR-10 with a pretrained encoder model
evaluate_embeddings: evaluate embeddings using a Softmax Nearest Neighbor classifier and report top1 and top5 accuracy
make_embeddings: create feature embeddings for all images in a data loader using a pretrained encoder
make_snn: build a Softmax Nearest Neighbor classifier from training embeddings and labels with temperature scaling
init_model: initialize a ResNet or Wide ResNet encoder with a projection head and optional prediction head
